title: 第一章 山道，少年
lines: 巨大的宫殿,宛若水晶雕刻而成,看上去美轮美奂。
江尘与陆紫凝一眨眼,便是出现在了宫殿之上。正前方的大座上,一尊身穿无色织锦长袍,头长犄角的中年男子,正一脸笑意的看着两人。
“有朋自远方来,不亦乐乎。难得两位贵客光临,参加小女的婚礼,还请上座。”
江尘只觉得自己的身体忽然不受控制一般,径直临空腾起,与陆紫凝一道飞到了右上的座位旁。
江尘不敢造次,只得恭敬的回答道:“多谢前辈美意。只是不知我那无度师兄他现在······”
中年男子却是忽然仰头长叹一口气,像是在回忆着什么似的,许久才缓缓说道:“已经整整九亿年了,许久没有人再叫我一声前辈了。小兄弟你倒是让我想起了许多以前的事情。你也不必担心,你那师兄撞着大运了,眼下正在准备与小女的婚礼,你们很快就能见面了。”
江尘只觉得男子身上的气息很强大,至少不是他现在这个级别所能触及到的。于是乎恭敬的说道:“敢问前辈,我曾听闻龙族早已绝迹,为何会出现在天古主宰的墓葬之中呢?”
中年男子闻言,像是回忆伤心往事一般,显得有些落寞,许久才缓缓说道:“你们两个,以及我那贤婿都是星主吧?”
江尘也不隐瞒,很是干脆的点了点头,算是作了回答。
中年男子微笑着说道:“星主出现,太初大人的仇也算终于能报了。我龙族隐世这么多年,总算是要重见天日了。”
忽然,中年男子眼中射出一道厉芒,这道厉芒直接投射到了陆紫凝的身上,瞬间便让其感到浑身难受,不过十个呼吸之后,陆紫凝便是已然没有了疼痛之感。
中年男子眼中露出惊诧的神情,不过明显看得出他脸上的窃喜。
“来了三个,其中两个都能成为主宰,不过一个是天古星主宰,一个是天古星河主宰罢了。那剩下的这一个······”男子眼中便是再度折射出一道厉芒,这厉芒瞬间便是包裹到了江尘的身上。
江尘并未感到难受,反而浑身感到一阵亲切,让他产生了一种暖暖的感觉,这让江尘宛若丈二的和尚,有些摸不着头脑,只得愣在那里。
content_zh:
落神山,山高十万八千丈,虎视方圆万余里。落神山之所以出名,乃因在其山巅处,有着神叶帝国第一修真宗门——落神宗。

    落神宗已经建立无数岁月了,相传乃是远古时期,无为宗师所立。后经无数岁月,方成神叶帝国第一大宗门。故在近数万年的时间里,落神宗成了神叶帝国人人都想进入的宗门。

    但是,落神宗挑选弟子却是极其严苛的。首先,年龄不能超过十五岁,一旦超过十五岁,任凭你天资再高,都不会被选上;其次,必须要有较好的资质,或是能够引动蓝色以上的星力方可;最后,便是进行试练,通过的便能加入落神宗。

    虽然听着很简单,但是神叶帝国中人都是知道,想要通过试练,绝非简单的事情。所谓的试练,就是进入落神山后山,穿过妖兽森林,到达无妄台才算通过。而妖兽森林中,有着无数的妖兽,自然不是简单能通过的。

    而此刻,在入落神山的一处山道上,一个身穿银白色长袍,挽着发髻的少年,正独自前行。少年稚嫩的脸上透出一股死样的沉寂,眼中透着一丝凄凉,约莫十一二岁的年纪。这是十分普通的模样,就像是一堆黄沙中的一粒,毫不起眼。

    山道崎岖,怪石嶙峋。少年的额头上,豆大的汗珠,早已挂满,不算华丽的银白色长袍也是早已湿透。少年的脸上,却是透着一股坚毅的神情,心中对落神宗也是无比的渴望。

    少年名叫江尘,是个孤儿却又不是孤儿。他自小便没有见过自己的父母,也不知道自己的父母究竟是谁?他是被一个邋里邋遢的老道士,在一个溪涧捡到的。故而,他自小便是跟着老道士,日子过的还算清平。

    江尘自小便是叫老道士师尊,而老道士也像极了一个德高望重的师尊,虽然江尘很是尊敬他。但是那邋邋遢遢的样子,身上散发出的酸爽味道,还是让江尘有些无奈。

    只是江尘也没有想到,邋遢的老道士其实是个星修者,平日里不但对他很是疼爱,还打小就传授江尘星修功法。到现在,十二岁的江尘实力已经到了三星星师境,远非一般同龄之人所能达到的。

    神叶帝国,位于天古大陆东部,是最接近无尽海的国度。跟天古大陆其他国家一样,神叶帝国也是人人修炼,参详星力,也就是所谓的星修。

    星修不同于武修、灵修。武修于武道或是修炼斗气,灵修于天地灵气,都是能快速获得强大力量的。而星修则是修炼星力,无尽星空中,星辰无数。星力便是天地间无比神秘的存在。

    天古大陆,早在混沌初开之时,便有大贤者发现了星力的秘密,遂创出修炼星力的办法。又经无数岁月,无数先辈的悉心钻研,时至今日修炼星力的方法已经十分完善,也分成了无数的宗派,势力。

    而无疑,落神宗便是其中最具代表性的势力之一。
content_en:
Luoshen Mountain is one hundred and eight thousand feet high, with a tiger's eye covering more than ten thousand miles.The reason why Luoshen Mountain is famous is that on the top of the mountain, there is the Luoshen Sect, the number one cultivation sect in the Shenye Empire.

The Luoshen Sect has been established for countless years. According to legend, it was established by Grandmaster Wuwei in ancient times.After countless years, it became the largest sect in the Shenye Empire.Therefore, in the past tens of thousands of years, the Luoshen Sect has become the sect that everyone in the Shenye Empire wants to enter.

However, Luoshen Sect is extremely strict in selecting disciples.First of all, you cannot be over fifteen years old. Once you are over fifteen years old, no matter how talented you are, you will not be selected; secondly, you must have good qualifications, or be able to activate blue or above star power; finally, there is a trial, and those who pass can join Luo Shen Sect.

Although it sounds simple, everyone in the Shenye Empire knows that passing the trial is by no means an easy matter.The so-called trial is to enter the back mountain of Luoshen Mountain, pass through the Monster Forest, and reach Wuwang Platform before passing.There are countless monsters in the monster forest, so naturally it is not easy to pass through.

At this moment, on a mountain road leading to Luo Shen Mountain, a young man wearing a silver-white robe and a bun was walking alone.There was a deathly silence on the young boy's immature face, and a trace of desolation in his eyes. He was about eleven or twelve years old.This is a very ordinary appearance, just like a grain in a pile of yellow sand, inconspicuous.

The mountain road is rugged and the rocks are jagged.The young man's forehead was already covered with large beads of sweat, and his silver-white robe, even though it was not gorgeous, was already soaked through.There was a look of perseverance on the young man's face, and he had an incomparable longing for the Luo Shen Sect in his heart.

The young man's name is Jiang Chen. He is an orphan but not an orphan.He has not seen his parents since he was a child, and he does not know who his parents are. He was picked up in a stream by a slovenly old Taoist priest.Therefore, he had followed the old Taoist priests since he was a child, and his life was relatively peaceful.

Jiang Chen has called the old Taoist Shizun since he was a child, and the old Taoist priest also looks like a highly respected master, although Jiang Chen respects him very much.But the sloppy appearance and the sour smell exuding from his body still made Jiang Chen feel helpless.

But Jiang Chen didn't expect that the sloppy old Taoist priest was actually a star cultivator. Not only did he love him very much, but he also taught Jiang Chen the star cultivator technique since he was a child.By now, the twelve-year-old Jiang Chen's strength has reached the three-star master realm, which is far beyond what ordinary people of the same age can achieve.

The Shenye Empire is located in the eastern part of the Tiangu Continent and is the country closest to the Endless Sea.Like other countries in the Tiangu Continent, everyone in the Shenye Empire practices star power, which is the so-called star cultivation.

Star cultivation is different from martial arts and spiritual cultivation.Those who practice martial arts or dou qi, or spiritually practice the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, can quickly gain powerful power.Star cultivation, on the other hand, is about cultivating star power, and there are countless stars in the endless starry sky.Star power is an extremely mysterious existence between heaven and earth.

In the ancient continent, as early as the beginning of chaos, a great sage discovered the secret of star power and created a method to cultivate star power.After countless years and careful study by countless ancestors, the method of cultivating star power has now been perfected and divided into countless sects and forces.

There is no doubt that the Luo Shen Sect is one of the most representative forces.
